verdict.rationale: The pack contains no first-party documentation of a public REST or HTTP API for Bitbucket. The only nearby item is a truncated marketing line, "Build custom integrations", which never names an API. The OpenAPI probes on support.atlassian.com returned 404, but those paths are not the API's likely host, so this is absence of evidence rather than a contradiction. The official MCP server belongs to a separate story and does not transfer here.
